summary: Iter198 retest of the ONE bug flagged in iter197 (batch-card m² subtotal not rendering). Root cause: search endpoint /warehouse/products was not enriching embedded batches with total_m2. Fix has now landed in routes/warehouse.py::search_warehouse_products (L435-442) — same m2_per_piece derivation used by list_product_batches. Backend: 8/8 pytest tests pass — including 3 NEW iter198 tests that verify search-endpoint enrichment for (a) sqm_per_piece path → total_m2=3.60 for 10 pieces × 0.36, (b) tile_width*tile_height fallback path → total_m2=1.80 for 5 pieces × (600×600 mm), (c) product with neither sqm_per_piece nor tile dims returns 200 with total_m2 absent. Iter197's 4 per-product endpoint tests + iter196's soft-delete regression all continue to pass. Frontend: verified live at /admin/warehouse — searched for TEST-M2-FE-0c0564 (sqm_per_piece=0.36, batch of 10 pieces), expanded product row, batch card now renders '10 PIECES' with '3.60 m²' subtotal exactly as expected. Product-row StockBadge also shows both '10 PIECE' and '3.60 m²'. DETAILS header rename, Group-by-product default-ON toggle, bold black BATCH NUMBER pill and grey Unslotted fallback all rendered correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: routes/warehouse.py search_warehouse_products (L417-442): m2_per_piece derivation is unified across product-level coverage_m2 and per-batch total_m2 — good DRY. tile_m2_per_piece is preferred over sqm_per_piece which is correct since it's the product-model field.

routes/warehouse.py: enrichment guard `if m2_per_piece:` correctly skips when derivation failed. Also guarded by `if pieces:` inside the loop — total_m2 will not be stamped if total_pieces is 0/None, matches per-product endpoint semantics.
Warehouse.jsx BatchCard (L332-336): render guard `batch.total_m2 != null && Number(batch.total_m2) > 0` is defensive against both null AND string-'0' edge cases — good.
Warehouse.jsx BatchesPanel reads product.batches from the search endpoint's embedded array — no extra fetch on expand, single-request pattern preserved.

test_warehouse_batch_m2.py: 8 total tests now cover both search + per-product endpoints, tile-dim fallback, missing-info tolerance, bad-value tolerance and the iter196 soft-delete regression. Uses fixture-scoped PIN so re-runs don't collide.

success_rate.backend: 100% (8/8 tests pass — 4 iter197 per-product + 3 NEW iter198 search-endpoint + 1 soft-delete regression)

rca of the issue: Iter197 fixed enrichment only in list_product_batches (per-product endpoint), but the frontend BatchesPanel reads batches from the search endpoint's embedded array so the m² subtotal never made it to the UI. Iter198 fix duplicates the exact same m2_per_piece derivation (tile_m2_per_piece → sqm_per_piece → tile_width*tile_height fallback) inside search_warehouse_products and stamps b['total_m2'] on each active batch in the map. Verified end-to-end: pytest asserts search response total_m2 == 3.60, and live UI now renders '3.60 m²' inside the batch card. No regressions on the 4 existing iter197 tests or the iter196 soft-delete filter.
